definitions: The lair or shelter of a wild animal, especially a predatory mammal.
A small, comfortable room in a house, used for relaxing or private work.
A place where people meet to do something illegal or immoral.
A small, secluded place where children play.
examples: The fox retreated to its den.
He spent the evening reading in his den.
The police raided a gambling den.
The children built a den in the woods.
